definitions.explanation: The southernmost point of the Earth, or the Antarctic region in general. Used in geographic, scientific, and general contexts.

examples.japanese: {南極|なんきょく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧。
{南極|なんきょく}⟦{大陸|たいりく}→大陸：03400_tairiku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ペンギン→ペンギン：06500_pengin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: There are penguins on the Antarctic continent.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{観測隊|かんそくたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{南極|なんきょく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}っている→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: A Japanese observation team is conducting research in the Antarctic.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {南極|なんきょく}⟦{大陸|たいりく}→大陸：03400_tairiku⟧ (Antarctic continent)
- {南極|なんきょく}{点|てん} (South Pole, the exact point)
- {南極|なんきょく}⟦{観測|かんそく}→観測：00183_kansoku⟧ (Antarctic observation/research)
- {南極|なんきょく}⟦{探検|たんけん}→探検：17461_tanken⟧ (Antarctic expedition)

RELATED WORDS:
The opposite is ⟦{北極|ほっきょく}→北極：16689_hokkyoku⟧ (North Pole / Arctic). Japan has maintained a continuous Antarctic research presence since 1957, and the {南極|なんきょく}{観測隊|かんそくたい} (Antarctic observation team) is well known.
